name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday OCTOBER 12, 2017
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioners Aleman, Avery, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of September 14, 2017
Minutes for September 14, 2017
8. Public Hearing
8A. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-008
Mr. Dani Abdulaziz, Applicant
A request to establish an amusement arcade use located within an existing tenant space located at 2550 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-039 approving an amusement arcade use and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
CUP 17-008 Staff Report
8B. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-013
La Palma Mexican Food Bar and Grill, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 47 (On-Sale General) Alcoholic Beverage Control License for a bona fide restaurant located at 2162 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve the project subject to the findings and Conditions of Approval provided within Resolution No. PC-2017-037 and find that the project is exempt from CEQA. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
CUP 17-013 Staff Report
8C. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-011
Mr. Rafael Lee, Applicant
A request to allow the sale of tobacco / smoking products within an existing retail store located at 1813 East Palmdale Boulevard, Suite 14.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-036 approving the request to allow the sale of tobacco / smoking products within an existing retail store (Dollar House) and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
CUP 17-011 Staff Report
8D. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-005
Mr. Alejandro Chavez Ventura, Applicant
A request to develop an outdoor soccer recreation center located at the northwest corner of Avenue Q-7 and 8th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-035 approving the development of an outdoor soccer recreation center and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
CUP 17-005 Staff Report
9. Staff Communications
9A. Alcohol Permits/Public Convenience or Necessity
Noel Doran, Assistant City Attorney
9B. Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, November 9, 2017, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
www.ci tyofpalmdale.org
Auxiliary Aids provided for Communication Accessibility upon 72 hour notice and request.
